item.title: Match Report: Walsall 1-2 Notts County
item.description: Walsall fell to late defeat on Saturday afternoon as two second-half goals from visitors Notts County sealed a 2-1 loss for the Saddlers at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. A goal from Aaron Pressley on the brink of half time saw the Saddlers ahead, but they were unable to keep a clean sheet as Oliver Norburn and Jodi Jones got on the scoresheet late on. item.title: Match Report: Walsall Women 2-0 Telford Town
item.description: Walsall Women secured a crucial 2-0 victory over Telford Town Ladies at Dales Lane on Sunday afternoon. Phoebe Smith’s first half header kept the Saddlers on top, before Ruby Mayo’s late effort wrapped up the victory for Walsall.
